requirements_summary: SaaS product team building in-app KB search. Moderate index: 50k-300k docs (expect ~2M vector shards after chunking). Target sustained QPS: 200-400 (peak bursts to 1k). UX latency target: median end-to-end <60ms (95th <150ms). Pipeline: vector retrieval (approx ANN) + cross-encoder rerank on top-10. Embedding dim preference: 1536-2048 depending on model; open to Redwood-curated models. Cost sensitivity: unit cost must be competitive (goal <$0.01/query avg including rerank). Security: SOC2/SAML required, DPA + retention controls. Evaluation focus: hosting simplicity, predictable latency at scale, autoscaling behavior under burst, caching effectiveness for prefix/repeat queries, and reranker token cost control.
